forecast.normalization: per-series mean and sample standard deviation from rows strictly before each rolling origin
forecast.validation: last 15 percent of eligible strided training origins by time
forecast.timestamp_caveat: The parser drops any source row with a missing or nonnumeric selected series. Position leads and windows therefore remain processed-row positions; target UTC dates are retained for auditing.

models.name: TargetSelfContext-Matched
models.context: value-mapped target encoding; neighbor attention is still evaluated as a zero-weight audit path
models.match_contract: same instantiated parameters, prediction head, optimizer, epochs, batches, seeds, and parameterized forward path as CSA-Poincare-Shared

models.name: UniformCrossSeries-Matched
models.context: uniform mean of value-mapped neighbor encodings; learned scores are evaluated as a zero-weight audit path
models.match_contract: same instantiated parameters, prediction head, optimizer, epochs, batches, seeds, and parameterized forward path as CSA-Poincare-Shared

models.name: CSA-FixedScale-Shared
models.context: Poincare-distance aggregation with inverse-temperature fixed at one

models.name: CSA-Poincare-IndependentEncoder
models.encoder: six capacity-matched series-specific encoders with hidden widths 16,16,16,16,15,15 plus an effective 194-parameter calibration
models.scope_caveat: The total parameter count and downstream head are matched, but the independent encoder uses narrower per-series hidden layers and lower encoder arithmetic; this comparison cannot isolate sharing from width allocation.

training.optimizer: manual eager Adam beta1=0.9 beta2=0.999 epsilon=1e-8
training.loss: mean squared error on normalized targets
training.checkpoint_selection: lowest validation MSE over all eight completed epochs; no early termination
training.determinism: fixed CPU/CUDA seeds, deterministic cuDNN, cuDNN benchmark disabled, deterministic algorithms requested

statistics.seed_handling: average the five matched seed results within each method-origin before inference
statistics.primary_test: two-sided exact paired sign-flip test over eight origin-level differences
statistics.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the five frozen CSA-Poincare-Shared MAPE contrasts
statistics.interval: pointwise 95 percent percentile bootstrap over rolling origins with 20000 deterministic resamples

comparison_budget.confirmatory_scope: six component-identification methods on OPSD lead 24 only
comparison_budget.reason: This stage narrows the confirmatory family instead of treating historical three-seed architecture screens as equal-strength controls.
